_note: Structure for the full Fajr prayer (two rakahs). The content teammate completes every TODO (instructions, dhikr, sources, audio) and has everything Sharia-reviewed before release. Do not invent hadith numbers or sources. Every step is defined ONCE here; "order" lists it as many times as the prayer performs it, so the second rakah reuses the same reviewed text.

preparation.text: The time for Fajr has started.
preparation.source: الدرر السنية، الموسوعة الفقهية: اشتراط دخول الوقت
الدرر السنية، الموسوعة الفقهية: الطهارة من الحدث

preparation.text: Your body, clothes and place are clean.
preparation.source: الدرر السنية، الموسوعة الفقهية: الطهارة من النجس

preparation.text: Your body is covered as required.
preparation.detail: Male (10+): cover from navel to knees. Female: cover the entire body except face and hands.
preparation.source: الدرر السنية، الموسوعة الفقهية: حد العورة في الصلاة
preparation.source2: IslamQA (English) — Conditions of the Validity of Prayer

preparation.text: You are facing the direction of the Ka'bah.
preparation.source: الدرر السنية، الموسوعة الفقهية: استقبال القبلة

preparation.text: You intend in your heart to pray Fajr.

to_jalsa.instruction: Say “Allāhu Akbar” as you rise from Sujūd to the sitting position. Do not raise your hands.

to_sujood.instruction: Say “Allāhu Akbar” as you go down into Sujūd . Do not raise your hands.

to_standing.instruction: Say “Allāhu Akbar” as you rise from Sujūd to stand for the second Rak‘ah. Do not raise your hands.

to_tashahhud.instruction: Say “Allāhu Akbar” as you rise from Sujūd to the sitting position for Tashahhud. Do not raise your hand

title.en: takbirat al'iihram — The opening Allahu Akbar

instruction.en: raise the hands to the shoulders or the ears
standing and placing the hands on  the chest the right hand over the left
While standing, recite Surat Al-Fatihah from beginning to end.

steps.reference: الحمد لله رب العالمين الرحمن الرحيم مالك يوم الدين اياك نعبد واياك نستعين اهدنا الصراط المستقيم صراط الذين انعمت عليهم غير المغضوب عليهم ولا الضالين

verses.meaning: Praise be to Allah, The Lord of the worlds.
The Possessor of the Day of Doom.
You only do we worship, and You only do we beseech for help.
Guide us in the straight Path.

verses.arabic: صراط الذين أنعمت عليهم غير المغضوب عليهم ولا الضالين
verses.transliteration: Sirata allatheena anAAamta AAalayhim ghayri almaghdoobi AAalayhim wala addalleen
verses.meaning: The Path of the ones whom You have favored, other than that of the ones against whom You are angered, and not (that of) the erring. (It is customary to say "amin" "amen" at the end of this Surah).

sunnahVerses.meaning: In The Name of Allah, The All-Merciful, The Ever-Merciful.

instruction.en: raise the hands to the shoulders      or the ears while saying: “Allāhu  Akbar”. Then bow into Rukū
Say “Allāhu Akbar” as you go down into Sujūd. Do not raise your hands.
raise the hands to the shoulders      or the ears while rising from  Rukū saying: “Sami‘allāhu li-man hamidah”

meaning.en: Allah hears he who praises Him

instruction.en: support oneself with the hands on the knees when bowing, fingers spread apart, arms away from one’s sides, back straight, not raising one’s head nor lowering it

meaning.en: Glory be to my Lord, the Ever-Magnificent
Our Lord, to You belongs all praise

instruction.en: prostrate using seven body parts: the forehead with the nose, both hands, both knees, and both feet. facing the Qiblah with his fingers and toes

meaning.en: Glory be to my Lord, the Most High

title.en: Juloos — sitting between the two prostrations

instruction.en: Sit on your left foot, keep your right foot upright, and point the toes of your right foot toward the Qiblah.
Sit on your left foot, keep your right foot upright, and point the toes of your right foot toward the Qiblah. and say:

dhikr.arabic: التحيات لله والصلوات والطيبات، السلام عليك أيها النبي ورحمة الله وبركاته، السلام علينا وعلى عباد الله الصالحين، أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله وأشهد أن محمدًا عبده ورسوله، اللهم صل على محمد وعلى آل محمد كما صليت على إبراهيم وعلى آل إبراهيم إنك حميد مجيد.
dhikr.transliteration: At-tahiyyātu lillāhi was-salawātu wattayyibātu, as-salāmu ‘alayka ayyuha an-nabyyu wa rahmatullāhi wa barakātuh as-salāmu ‘alayna wa ‘ala ‘ibādillāh as-sālihīn; ashhadu an la ilāha illa Allah, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan ‘abduhu wa rasūluh, Allāhumma salli ‘ala Muhammadin wa ‘ala āli Muhammad kama sallayta ‘ala Ibrāhīma wa ‘alā āli Ibrāhīm, innaka Hamīdun Majīd

meaning.en: All greetings, prayers, and good things are due to Allah. May the peace, blessings, and mercy of Allah be upon you, O Prophet. Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah. I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger,O Allah, bestow Your peace upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You have bestowed Your peace upon Abraham and the family of Abraham; indeed, You are Praiseworthy and Glorious

instruction.en: Turn your head to the right while offering Salaam then immediately turn your head to the left while repeating it

meaning.en: Peace be upon you and the mercy of Allah

instruction.en: Rise to stand for the second rakah.
